title: 第11章 金线莲第12章 背蒋倩下山
content_zh:
叶开把姑娘的绳子解开，姑娘冲叶开磕头：“谢谢大哥救命之恩！”
叶开赶紧把姑娘扶起来，“别呀，咱俩不定谁大呢，你这一磕头，我还得掏红包给你，我可受不起！”
姑娘被叶开逗的扑哧笑了，她站起来，把凌乱的衣服理了理。
“你怎么来这里，你不知道这里正在闹鬼吗？”
姑娘脸上愁云密布，她叹了口气，
“唉，我也没办法，要不是被逼急了，谁来这里啊！”
“你说说，有什么困难？”
“我爸爸病了，请名医开了个方子，需要一味野生的药，只有桃花山才能采到。”
“你一个大姑娘跑来山上采药多危险，就不能让男人来吗？”
“这不是闹鬼吗，没人敢来呀，没办法，我只能自己亲自过来了。”
“你家里就找不出一个男的愿意过来？”
“别人来了也没用，他们不认识那种药，只有我认识。”
“哦，原来是这样啊。”
姑娘冲着倒在地上的两个汉子的裆部踢了一脚。
只听“砰砰“两声响，两个汉子龇牙咧嘴惨嚎一声，抱着裆部蜷缩成一团。
“叫你们欺负本姑娘，我揍死你们！”
歪嘴看了连连后退，“姑奶奶，别打我，我是被他们逼的。”
他一不小心，拌在一块石头上，摔倒在地，抱着脑袋哎呦哎呦地叫着。
姑娘乐得哈哈大笑，“活该，摔死你，臭流氓！”
走出山洞，姑娘打量着叶开，

“帅哥你叫什么名字？”
“我叫叶开，你呢？”
“我叫蒋倩。”
“你来这里找什么药？”
“金线莲。”
“走吧，我帮你找。”
“你能找到吗？”
“试试呗。”
叶开尝试着四处瞭望，突然发现自己能看的很远，几百米外的一棵树，甚至树叶都看的清清楚楚。
蒋倩一旁问道：“大哥，你看啥的，那么入神？”
叶开扭头朝蒋倩看去，这一看不要紧，把他吓了一跳。
蒋倩竟然一丝不挂地站在他的面前，那高耸挺拔的双峰，那纤细的腰身，那浑圆的水蜜桃……
叶开看傻眼了，一股滚烫的液体从鼻子里流出来。
叶开用手一摸，鼻血！
蒋倩还不知道怎么回事呢，嘻嘻笑了。
她指着叶开的鼻子，“叶开，你鼻血都出来了。”
叶开尴尬地说：“天干物燥，小心着火。最近吃了些好东西，上火了。”
“多喝点水。”
蒋倩从随身背着的包里掏出一瓶水递给叶开。
叶开不敢再看蒋倩，他这才知道，刚才他极目远眺的时候，无意中开了天眼。

他喝了几口水，稳了稳，突然想到可以用天眼来寻找药草。
content_en:
Ye Kai untied the girl's rope, and the girl kowtowed to Ye Kai: "Thank you, brother, for saving your life!"
Ye Kai quickly helped the girl up and said, "No, we don't know who is older. If you kowtow, I have to give you a red envelope. I can't bear it!"
The girl burst into laughter because of Ye Kai's teasing. She stood up and straightened her messy clothes.
"Why are you here? Don't you know this place is haunted?"
The girl's face was filled with sorrow, and she sighed,
"Oh, I can't help it. If I hadn't been forced into a hurry, who would have come here!"
"Tell me, what are the difficulties?"
"My father is ill and asked a famous doctor to prescribe a prescription. He needs wild medicine, which can only be obtained in Peach Blossom Mountain."
"It's very dangerous for a big girl like you to come to the mountains to collect medicine, so why can't men be allowed to come?"
"Isn't this haunted? No one dares to come. I have no choice but to come here myself."
"Can't you find a man in your family willing to come over?"
"It's useless for others to come. They don't know the medicine. Only I know it."
"Oh, so that's it."
The girl kicked the two men on the ground in the crotch.
Just two "bang bang" sounds were heard, and the two men bared their teeth and howled miserably, hugging their crotches and curling up into a ball.
"If I tell you to bully me, I'll beat you to death!"
He looked crookedly and backed away, "Auntie, don't hit me, I was forced by them."
He accidentally stumbled onto a stone and fell to the ground, holding his head and screaming.
The girl laughed happily, "You deserve it, I'll beat you to death, you stinky scoundrel!"
After walking out of the cave, the girl looked at Ye Kai.
"What's your name, handsome?"
"My name is Ye Kai, what's yours?"
"My name is Jiang Qian."
"What medicine are you looking for here?"
"Anomatis."
"Let's go, I'll help you find it."
"Can you find it?"
"Let's try it."
Ye Kai tried to look around, and suddenly found that he could see very far away. He could clearly see even the leaves of a tree hundreds of meters away.
Jiang Qian asked from the side: "Brother, what are you looking at, so fascinated?"
Ye Kai turned his head and looked at Jiang Qian. This sight didn't matter and startled him.
Jiang Qian stood naked in front of him, with her tall and straight peaks, her slender waist, and her round peach...
Ye Kai was dumbfounded, and a stream of hot liquid flowed out of his nose.
Ye Kai touched it with his hand and saw a nosebleed!
Jiang Qian didn't know what was going on yet, so she giggled.
She pointed at Ye Kai's nose, "Ye Kai, your nose is bleeding."
Ye Kai said awkwardly: "It's dry and dry, so be careful of catching fire. I've eaten some good food recently and got angry."
"Drink more water."
Jiang Qian took out a bottle of water from the bag she was carrying and handed it to Ye Kai.
Ye Kai didn't dare to look at Jiang Qian anymore. Only then did he realize that when he looked far into the distance just now, he accidentally opened his eyes.
He drank some water, stabilized himself, and suddenly thought that he could use his clairvoyance to find medicinal herbs.
